Boxing stance

Stance: Orthodox places your left side forward. Southpaw places your right side forward and adjusts lead and rear instructions.

Audio and display

Voice callouts: Turns the spoken coach instructions on or off.Show workout time left: Shows or hides the smaller total-workout countdown below the main timer.Show top status: Shows or hides the Ready, Running, or Finished status at the top.Show secondary format: Displays punch names below numbers, or numbers below punch names.Show keyboard shortcuts: Shows or hides the assigned keys inside the workout control buttons.

Keyboard shortcuts

Start or pause: Starts the workout or pauses the current countdown.Next round: Skips the current warmup, work, or rest phase and starts the appropriate next round.Previous round: Returns to the preceding round. From rest, it repeats the round that just ended.Mute voice: Quickly turns spoken callouts on or off.

Select a field, then press the key you want to assign. If that key is already used, the two shortcuts switch places.
